title: On the Unary Function Clone Problem via Parametrized Arithmetic Functionals
content: Attempts to solve the Unary Function Clone Problem in Clone Theory have primarily focused on classifying unary fragments within primitive recursive and elementary function hierarchies. Conventional methods have considered closure properties, growth rates, and function arity. This treatise introduces an original, parameterized framework that formulates the elementary arithmetic operations as members of a unified unary family of arity-indexed functionals. Our theory is consistent with Kalmar’s class of elementary functions, Peano Arithmetic, categorical-Lawvere and Gödelian semantics. Utilizing a single iteration parameter system, we show that these operations, though algebraically expressible, are clone-theoretically independent. We prove a minimal unary basis capable of generating the full arithmetic clone under composition.
